trans-unit.source: An input layer is a layer that just takes data provided from outside the network and passes it on to the next layer(s)

trans-unit.source: A dense layer, also called fully-connected layer, is a layer whose inside neurons connect to every neuron in the preceding layer.
trans-unit.target: Tankusis sluoksnis, dar vadinamas visiškai sujungtu sluoksniu, - tai sluoksnis, kurio vidiniai neuronai jungiasi su kiekvienu ankstesnio sluoksnio neuronu.

Now add your data in the following format

Each row needs to represent one set containing the features and the label. Seperate items with a comma (spaces before and after the comma are okay). The single last item always represents the label while the items before it represent the features. Make sure to use only dots and no commas for floating point values. If you have data in CSV format, you can just paste it here but make sure to remove any comments.

Paskutinis elementas visada yra etiketė, o prieš jį esantys elementai - savybės. Įsitikinkite, kad slankiojo kablelio reikšmėms naudojami tik taškai, o ne kableliai. For val_..., the metric is calculated on the validation data set while for the data without val as a prefix the metric is calculated on the training data set. The metrics for the validation data set can be seen as more meaningful since this is the data the network does not 'know'.

trans-unit.source: The Pima Indians Diabetes data set involves predicting the onset of diabetes within 5 years in Pima Indians given medical details. It is a binary (2-class) classification problem. The number of observations for each class is not balanced. There are 768 observations with 8 input variables and 1 output variable. Missing values are believed to be encoded with zero values.
trans-unit.target: Pima indėnų diabeto duomenų rinkinys apima diabeto atsiradimo per penkerius metus prognozę Pima indėnams, atsižvelgiant į jų medicininę informaciją. Tai dvinarė (2 klasių) klasifikavimo problema. Kiekvienos klasės stebėjimų skaičius nėra subalansuotas. Yra 768 stebėjimai su 8 įvesties kintamaisiais ir 1 išvesties kintamuoju. Manoma, kad trūkstamos reikšmės koduojamos nulinėmis reikšmėmis.
